title: CSS layout
summary: Style a page from selectors and the cascade through the box model, a flex row, a flex card, a grid page, and a responsive breakpoint. You will reproduce the specificity mistake that keeps a rule from winning, watch a card overflow until box-sizing fixes it, and see the layout change when the result pane narrows.
changeNote: Rewritten so each step opens with an explainer or a prediction, folds the background under Read more, and ends with a quiz.
